title: The Last Broadcast
description:
3 Missions · Single Player vs AI

An armistice has been signed. In the border highlands, the telephone lines are down and the only transmitter that can reach both sides has fallen silent. By dawn, the fighting could begin again. Reopen the line, get the station back on the air, and make sure the border posts hear the order to stand down.

completionText:
Campaign Complete

Just before dawn, the transmitter came back on the air.

“All border posts, this is Hilltop Station. The armistice is in effect. Cease fire and hold your positions.”

For a moment, there was only static. Then a post across the valley answered. A second voice came from the other side of the ridge. By sunrise, every post had acknowledged the order.

You’ve completed The Last Broadcast.

missions.title: The Relay House
missions.briefing:
The Relay House
The last message from the highlands came through this relay house. The operator reported a break in the line and then went silent. An enemy detachment now holds the road. Clear the outpost so our signal crew can reach the house and find where the line failed.

Objective
Destroy the enemy headquarters.

Field note
The road is the shortest route. Stone walls and woodland offer cover on the approach.
missions.victoryText:
The Line Is Traced
The relay house is secure. The operator is alive. She traced the break as far as the railway yard before the line went dead. The yard has the spare cable we need to reach the station.

missions.title: The Cable Yard
missions.briefing:
The spare cable is in the railway workshop. The yard is still occupied, and the signal crew is waiting outside. Clear the yard so they can get the cable uphill before dark.

Objective
Destroy the enemy headquarters.

Field note
The tracks leave your units exposed. The workshop buildings offer a covered approach through the yard.
missions.victoryText:
The Cable Is On Its Way
The crew has loaded the cable onto a truck. The road to the ridge is open as far as the last bend. From there, we can see a light in the station window. The transmitter crew may still be inside.

missions.title: The Hilltop Station
missions.briefing:
The signal crew has restored the line up to the station gate. The transmitter is intact, but the enemy still holds the ridge. Clear the last position and give the operators time to get the armistice on the air. The border posts are expecting orders at dawn.

Objective
Destroy the enemy headquarters.

Field note
The road climbs straight toward the station. A longer approach runs along the wooded slope. Keep enough units back to cover your own headquarters.
